name: pmfbyclaim_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for PMFBY loss claim authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: pmfbyclaim_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT process claims. Fails if OTP expired.

name: pmfbyclaim_validate_policy
description: Validates whether farmer has an active PMFBY policy for the specified crop and land. Claim can ONLY be filed if policy is active and crop-land mapping matches. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit claims. Fails if no active policy found or crop-land mismatch.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_check_claim_window
description: Checks whether the claim reporting window is still open. Loss must be reported within 72 hours. Requires session_token. Does NOT extend window. Fails if no active disaster event.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_report_loss_event
description: Reports a crop loss event. Transitions claim_status to 'reported'. Must be within 72-hour window. Policy must be active. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit formal claim. Fails if policy not active, window expired, loss_type unsupported, or duplicate report.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_submit_claim
description: Submits formal claim for reported loss. Transitions claim_status to 'submitted'. Loss must be reported first. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve claims. Fails if loss not reported or duplicate claim.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_upload_evidence
description: Uploads structured evidence for a claim. Claim must be in 'reported' or 'submitted' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve claims. Fails if claim beyond submitted status.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_track_claim_status
description: Tracks claim lifecycle status ('not_reported' through 'compensated'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify claim. Fails if claim_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_track_survey_status
description: Tracks field survey status for claim. Returns survey_status. Survey/assessment required before approval. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate surveys. Fails if no survey assigned.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_get_assessment_result
description: Retrieves damage assessment results including loss percentage, affected area, and assessment_status. Survey must be completed. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify assessment. Fails if survey not completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_calculate_compensation
description: Calculates compensation amount based on assessment results. Compensation depends on severity (partial vs full loss). Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse payment. Fails if assessment not completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_track_payment
description: Tracks compensation payment status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'credited', 'failed'). Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate payment. Fails if claim not approved.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_raise_grievance
description: Raises grievance. Categories: 'claim_rejected', 'survey_delay', 'incorrect_assessment', 'payment_delay', 'duplicate_claim_issue'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if invalid category.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmfbyclaim_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks grievance status. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
